learning_outcomes.text: Understanding physical phenomena and mastering basic concepts and principles of physics.
Developing skills to operate with mathematical formalism in solving applied physics problems.
Forming practical abilities necessary for other disciplines that use physics principles and laws.
Applying theoretical and practical knowledge acquired to solve problems in the field of engineering sciences.

syllabus_topics: Physical meanings of some mathematical quantities
Calorimetry. Determining the efficiency of an electric heater (Laboratory)
Ohm's Law. Electrical resistance and electrical power (Laboratory)
Optical lens. Determining the focal length of the lens (Laboratory)
Light absorption. Determining the absorption coefficient (Laboratory)

assessment_methods.method: Written exam at the end of the semester

assessment_rules: Correct answers to elementary questions and a start to solving the applied part, demonstrating mastery of fundamental Physics knowledge. Grades from the written exam and applied activity throughout the semester must be greater than or equal to 5.
